_about: Hand-vouched corrections to the film and TV matcher, the screen side's seeds.json. Keyed by TMDb title. film and tv: pins, albums the rules turn away, each taking its row after resolve ahead of any matcher claim and never carrying weakMatch. exclude: one-off albums that name the title but are another work, removed before resolve so the title falls to its next album. seasonlessVolumes: shows whose volume albums span seasons, filed season-less whatever their release dates. Cover and knockoff acts belong in collect._SCREEN_TRIBUTE, not here.
